subject: Next steps: SableCore commercial path & budget-holder roadmap
messages:
From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@sablecore.com>, Priya Narayanan <priya.n@sablecore.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: SableCore commercial path & budget-holder roadmap

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the proposed action items so we have alignment on the procurement path and signatory lanes. If anything below is off, flag it and I’ll update.

Top takeaways from the call:
- Use case: model-assisted clinical triage for inbound referrals (low-latency scoring at scale).
- Timing: pilot in Q4, goal to move to a contracted pilot by mid-November.
- Pricing sensitivity: primary threshold is $50k annual — above that procurement prefers PO; below that they can use card.

My asks / next steps:
1) Confirm preferred payment route (PO vs card) and whether SableCore’s marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) is a viable option for your procurement team.
2) Share the finance owner who will approve spend and the legal contact for contract redlines.
3) I’ve attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and a short commercial options slate — please review and highlight any blockers.

Attachments: SableCore_MAP_v1.xlsx; Redwood_Commercial_Options_v2.pdf

Proposed mutual actions:
- SableCore confirms payment route & budget owner — by 2026-09-13
- Redwood to prepare pilot SOW and draft contract (standard terms) — by 2026-09-17
- Scheduling: 30-min follow-up with procurement + finance (suggest 9/14 or 9/15)

Thanks — I’ll loop in our CS lead to coordinate the SOW and technical onboarding once budget and payment path are confirmed.

—
Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@sablecore.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Priya Narayanan <priya.n@sablecore.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: SableCore commercial path & budget-holder roadmap

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement/finance side:

- Payment route: For pilots under $50k we can usually run on a corporate card. For anything expected to exceed $50k/year procurement requires a PO and P-card routing (we submit a PO and our AP team pays via ACH).
- Marketplace: We prefer marketplace where possible (AWS Marketplace) because it simplifies procurement and governance, but it depends on whether the subscription terms and data residency match our needs. If Redwood has a marketplace listing we’d consider it first.
- Budget owner: The economic owner for this initiative will be Priya Narayanan (Finance — IT Budgets). She’s added here.
- Legal: Legal / procurement will want to see standard security addenda and a short exhibit for data handling; cc’d Priya to loop Legal if needed.

On the timing: 9/14 at 10am PT works for the procurement + finance sync.

I attached our internal PO policy excerpt for reference.

—
Tom Reynolds
Head of IT Procurement | SableCore Inc.
tom.reynolds@sablecore.com | +1 206-555-0199

Attachments: SableCore_PO-policy.pdf

From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@sablecore.com>, Priya Narayanan <priya.n@sablecore.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: SableCore commercial path & budget-holder roadmap

Tom — perfect, thanks. Looping in Marissa (CS lead) and Ben (commercial ops) to keep coordination tight. 

Marissa / Ben — Priya is the finance owner. Per Tom, SableCore’s procurement will require a PO if we go above ~ $50k/year and they'd prefer marketplace if our offering is compatible. Can we: 
- Marissa: draft the pilot SOW (stub) with estimated units and onboarding milestones.
- Ben: prepare two price rows in the commercial options: card-monthly (pilot low commitment) and PO-annual (discounted, projected 12-month spend). Include a marketplace sku if possible.

Tom / Priya — I’m attaching the MAP and a compressed commercial options doc. If you can confirm the PO approver name and the signatory (who signs SOW/contract on SableCore side) that’ll let us finish the materials for the 9/14 call.

Proposed 9/14 10:00am PT meeting: procurement (Tom), finance (Priya), Redwood: Alex + Marissa + Ben. I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks —
—
Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Narayanan <priya.n@sablecore.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@sablecore.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: SableCore commercial path & budget-holder roadmap

Alex / Team — confirming the details from finance:

- Budget holder: Priya Narayanan (Finance — IT Budgets). I’m the approver for pilot spend up to $75k; above that I escalate to EVP Finance.
- Signatory: Our legal prefers that program SOWs are countersigned by the Head of Partnerships (Laura Kim), but procurement can accept an initial PO to start provisioning.
- Marketplace: please include an AWS Marketplace pricing line if Redwood has a SKUs/pricing; that will accelerate approvals.

I reviewed the MAP and the options doc; two small asks:
1) Can Redwood produce a short two-page SOW (pilot scope + deliverables + standard SLAs) so we can attach it to the PO?
2) Please send a DocuSign envelope for the pilot SOW (we prefer digital signature for SOW acceptance).

I’ll be on the 9/14 call but if you can get the SOW stub ahead of time that will help.

—
Priya Narayanan
Finance Manager, IT Budgets | SableCore Inc.
priya.n@sablecore.com | +1 646-555-0133

Attachments mentioned: none (referenced internal PO policy already shared).
